```{r}
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
cell.cycle <- c(s.genes,g2m.genes)
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[AB][VDJC]", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)
ig_genes <- grep("^IG[JHKL][VDJCMG]", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)
ribo <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)
mito <- grep("^MT-", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(merge), value = TRUE)
bad_genes <- c(cell.cycle, tcr_genes, ig_genes, ribo, mito, hemoglobin, "XIST")
```
= 
```{r}
t.benign <- subset(merge, final.clones == "non_malig")

rna.assay <- CreateAssayObject(data = t.benign@assays$SCT$data, key = "rna_")
t.benign@assays$RNA <- rna.assay
DefaultAssay(t.benign) <- "RNA"
t.benign <- FindVariableFeatures(t.benign, nfeatures = 1500)
vf <- VariableFeatures(t.benign)
vf <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, hemoglobin, "XIST"))
```


```{r}
DefaultAssay(t.benign) <- "SCT"

VariableFeatures(t.benign) <- vf

t.benign <- ScaleData(t.benign, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")
t.benign <- RunPCA(t.benign)
t.benign <- RunHarmony(t.benign, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
t.benign <- RunUMAP(t.benign, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony", reduction.name = "umap.t.benign", return.model = T)
DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign", group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()

t.benign <- FindNeighbors(t.benign, reduction = "harmony", graph.name = c("harmony.t_nn", "harmony.t_snn"))
t.benign <- FindClusters(t.benign, resolution = c(0.1,0.2,0.5), graph.name = "harmony.t_snn")

DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign", group.by = "harmony.t_snn_res.0.1", label = T)
DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign", group.by = "harmony.t_snn_res.0.2", label = T)
DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign", group.by = "harmony.t_snn_res.0.5", label = T)
```


```{r}
DefaultAssay(t.benign) <- "RNA"
markers.t <- FindAllMarkers(t.benign, group.by = "harmony.t_snn_res.0.5", min.pct = .1, only.pos = T, max.cells.per.ident = 5000)
markers.t$dif <- markers.t$pct.1 - markers.t$pct.2
markers.t$p_flip <- 1/(markers.t$p_val_adj+.000000001)

markers.t.ss <- markers.t %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  arrange(desc(dif)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 20)
DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign", group.by = "harmony.t_snn_res.0.5", label = T)

```

mat <- t.benign@assays$SCT@data
Monaco <- MonacoImmuneData()
res <- SingleR(mat, ref=Monaco, labels=Monaco$label.fine, num.threads = 16)
df <- data.frame("pred.monaco" = res$labels)
rownames(df) <- rownames(res)
t.benign <- AddMetaData(t.benign, df)
DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign", group.by = "pred.monaco", label = T, label.size = 3)+NoLegend()

```{r}
t.malig <- subset(merge, final.clones == "malig")

rna.malig <- CreateAssay5Object(data = t.malig@assays$SCT$data, key = "rna_")

t.malig@assays$RNA <- rna.malig

DefaultAssay(t.malig) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(t.benign) <- "RNA"

t.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = t.benign, query = t.malig, dims = 1:30,
    reference.reduction = "pca", reference.assay = "RNA", query.assay = "RNA", features = vf)
t.malig <- MapQuery(anchorset = t.anchors, reference = t.benign, query = t.malig,
    refdata = list(harmony.t_snn_res.0.5 = "harmony.t_snn_res.0.5", pred.monaco = "pred.monaco"), reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap.t.benign")

DimPlot(t.benign, reduction = "umap.t.benign")
DimPlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.harmony.t_snn_res.0.5")
DimPlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.pred.monaco")

FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "PTPRC")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "CD3E")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "CD4")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "CD8A")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "CD8B")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "TRBC1")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "TRDC")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "NKG7")
FeaturePlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", features = "FOXP3")

DimPlot(t.malig, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "orig.ident", label = T)+NoLegend()


benign.umap <- t.benign@reductions$umap.t.benign@cell.embeddings
malig.umap <- t.malig@reductions$ref.umap@cell.embeddings
colnames(malig.umap) <- colnames(benign.umap)
t.umap <- rbind(benign.umap, malig.umap)
table(merge$celltype)
t.cells <- subset(merge, celltype == "T_Cells")
aligned_umap_embeddings <- t.umap[colnames(t.cells), , drop = FALSE]
t.umap <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = t.umap, assay = "SCT")
t.cells@reductions$umap.t.cells <- t.umap

clusters.benign <- as.character(t.benign$harmony.t_snn_res.0.5)
names(clusters.benign) <- colnames(t.benign)
clusters.malig <- t.malig$predicted.harmony.t_snn_res.0.5
names(clusters.malig) <- colnames(t.malig)
clusters.t <- c(clusters.benign, clusters.malig)

monaco.benign <- as.character(t.benign$pred.monaco)
names(monaco.benign) <- colnames(t.benign)
monaco.malig <- t.malig$predicted.pred.monaco
names(monaco.malig) <- colnames(t.malig)
monaco.t <- c(monaco.benign, monaco.malig)


DimPlot(t.cells, reduction = "umap.t.cells", split.by = "final.clones")
table(t.cells$clusters.t.cells)

saveRDS(t.umap, file = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/t.umap.rds")
saveRDS(clusters.t, file = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/clusters.t.rds")
saveRDS(monaco.t, file = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/monaco.t.rds")
saveRDS(markers.t, file = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/markers.t.rds")
saveRDS(markers, file = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/markers.rds")
```

#Remove all objects except the ones to keep
